title: End-to-End Deep Learning for 3D Protein Structure Prediction
pre_discovery_prompt: Predicting atomic 3D protein structures directly from primary amino acid sequence has been an open challenge for 50 years. How can neural architectures process multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) and spatial residue pair representations jointly?
ground_truth_finding: An axial attention block that iteratively updates 2D MSA representations and 2D pair representations symmetrically, passing updates to an invariant point attention structure module.
notes_on_reconstruction: Stripped AlphaFold 2 project name and DeepMind institution.
